Host board BIOS ESP PARTUUID and original EFI files pinned before stage/arm
CCFG and PCI identity read-only guards require restored FSP profile
Prior metadata and state fsynced before directory creation and EFI entry creation

Pending states written before mutations; verification errors preserve artifacts and prevent automatic later actions
